data.display_address: Azizi Vista, Dubai Studio City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Azizi Vista offers exclusive urban living in the heart of Dubai Studio City, designed for those who appreciate luxury and convenience. With its contemporary minimalist design, the 10-storey building offers studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments that exude sophistication while providing a cozy, comfortable atmosphere. The private balconies and panoramic windows offer impressive views of the city’s dynamic skyline, allowing residents to enjoy both privacy and the vibrant energy of Dubai.

Features and Amenities

• Swimming Pool
• Fully Equipped Gym
• Children’s Play Area
• Parks and Leisure Spaces
• 24/7 Security

The prime location of Azizi Vista provides unparalleled access to some of Dubai’s most iconic destinations. Whether you’re heading to the Dubai Marina, Expo City Dubai, or the Mall of the Emirates, all of these renowned locations are just a short drive away. The development is also conveniently close to key attractions like the Equestrian Club, Motor City, and Dubai Autodrome, making it the perfect home for those who seek both luxury and accessibility.
